NVIDIA BYPASS
=============

1. Put these files in:
   C:\Users\carzy\Downloads\nvidia byp

   - start.cmd
   - NvidiaBypSMOKEY.exe

2. Double-click start.cmd

3. Menu:
   [1] Sign Up      - create account (any username/password/key works)
   [2] Login        - login (any credentials work for now)
   [3] Reset Password
   [4] Exit

4. After login:
   [1] Inject All   - opens the ImGui menu
   [2] Logout
   [3] Exit

ImGui controls:
  - Streamproof (on by default)
  - Nvidia Bypass (checkbox to inject)
  - Menu Key (default INSERT to hide/show)
  - Unload
